title: RACI responsibility matrix
description: One accountable owner for each decision and clear roles at critical handoffs.

sources.title: UK Government Security, Agreeing roles and responsibilities with a RACI matrix

rules.instruction: Ask the project manager who does the work, who owns each decision, who must give input and who needs the outcome, and record the answers in a RACI matrix.
rules.verification: Check that each deliverable in the matrix has exactly one accountable owner and no overlapping authority before work starts.
